errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse bildet die Werte der „Entlasteten Lohnsteuer“ ab
errors.evidence: The description incompletely reports the y-axis label as 'Entlastete Lohnsteuer' (relieved wage tax), omitting the crucial first word 'Veränderung' (Change). The full, correct label is 'Veränderung Entlastete Lohnsteuer' (Change in relieved wage tax). This changes the meaning from an absolute value to a change in value.
